title: Exciter (AVR)
description: Excitation system of a synchronous machine: SEXS, IEEE Type 1, the alternator-rectifier EXAC1 / ESAC1A, or the static ESST4B. The CLI RMS study's typical, clearly indicative settings are the code defaults. Dynamics wiring: Mark-gated. markGated (N312, October 2026): false on every parameter a gridsim-dynamics/2 file feeds into the RMS study (F23, wired).

model.description: Exciter / AVR model. EXAC1 (IEEE 1981 AC1) and ESAC1A (IEEE 421.5-2005 AC1A) are the alternator-rectifier exciters: they read the machine's field current (rectifier regulation FEX and the demagnetising term KD) and take the ac... parameters, all required. ESST4B (IEEE 421.5-2005 ST4B) is the static exciter with outer voltage and inner field PI regulators fed from a potential and/or compound source: it reads the terminal voltage and current and the field current, and takes the st4b... parameters, all required.

sexsFieldMinPu.description: SEXS field voltage floor EMIN (pu on the machine base).

sexsFieldMaxPu.description: SEXS field voltage ceiling EMAX (pu on the machine base).

ieeet1RegulatorMinPu.description: IEEET1 regulator floor VRMIN (pu on the machine base).

ieeet1RegulatorMaxPu.description: IEEET1 regulator ceiling VRMAX (pu on the machine base).

acLeadS.description: AC exciter lead time constant TC (s); TB = TC = 0 bypasses the lead-lag. Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acLagS.description: AC exciter lag time constant TB (s). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acRegulatorGain.description: AC exciter regulator gain KA (above 0). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acRegulatorTimeS.description: AC exciter regulator time constant TA (s). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acRegulatorMinPu.description: Lower limit of the AC exciter regulator lag: VRMIN for EXAC1, VAMIN for ESAC1A (pu). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acRegulatorMaxPu.description: Upper limit of the AC exciter regulator lag: VRMAX for EXAC1, VAMAX for ESAC1A (pu). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acExciterTimeS.description: AC exciter time constant TE (s, above 0). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acFeedbackGain.description: AC exciter rate feedback gain KF. Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acFeedbackTimeS.description: AC exciter rate feedback time constant TF (s, above 0). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acRectifierKc.description: AC exciter rectifier loading factor KC (proportional to the commutating reactance). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acDemagnetisingKd.description: AC exciter demagnetising factor KD (armature reaction). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acExciterConstant.description: AC exciter constant KE (field resistance line slope). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acSatE1.description: AC exciter saturation point E1 (pu exciter voltage VE). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acSatSe1.description: AC exciter saturation factor SE(E1); SE1 = SE2 = 0 for none. Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acSatE2.description: AC exciter saturation point E2 (pu, above E1). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acSatSe2.description: AC exciter saturation factor SE(E2). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acOutputMinPu.description: ESAC1A regulator output lower limit VRMIN (pu). Required for model ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (EXAC1 has none).

acOutputMaxPu.description: ESAC1A regulator output upper limit VRMAX (pu). Required for model ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (EXAC1 has none).

st4bKpr.description: ESST4B outer (voltage) regulator proportional gain KPR. Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

st4bKir.description: ESST4B outer regulator integral gain KIR (per second); KIR = 0 needs KIM above 0. Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

st4bVrMaxPu.description: ESST4B outer regulator upper limit VRMAX (pu). Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

st4bVrMinPu.description: ESST4B outer regulator lower limit VRMIN (pu). Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

st4bTaS.description: ESST4B regulator lag TA (s). Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

st4bKpm.description: ESST4B inner (field voltage) regulator proportional gain KPM. Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

st4bKim.description: ESST4B inner regulator integral gain KIM (per second). Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

st4bVmMaxPu.description: ESST4B inner regulator upper limit VMMAX (pu). Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

st4bVmMinPu.description: ESST4B inner regulator lower limit VMMIN (pu). Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

st4bKg.description: ESST4B field voltage feedback gain KG. Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

st4bKp.description: ESST4B potential circuit gain KP. Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

st4bKi.description: ESST4B compound circuit (current) gain KI. Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

st4bVbMaxPu.description: ESST4B power source voltage ceiling VBMAX (pu, above 0). Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

st4bKc.description: ESST4B rectifier loading factor KC. Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

st4bXlPu.description: ESST4B potential source reactance XL (pu on the machine base). Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

st4bThetapDeg.description: ESST4B potential circuit phase angle THETAP (degrees). Required for model ESST4B in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.
